name: Detroit Edible | 200mg Barracuda Bar | Rosin Milk Chocolate
description:
NEW to our Barracuda Family - Live ROSIN Milk Chocolate!

Barracuda Milk Chocolate Bars are crafted from the highest-quality ingredients. The chocolate is made of 65% Belgian chocolate combined with the purest distillate from our very own Michigan-made Cannalicious Labs for the smoothest consumption experience to date. Each bar contains 200mg THC and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
